ibm.p1: Embedded in an enterprise client's IT organization. Maintained and extended legacy Java systems across the whole cycle, from design and coding to unit and integration testing.
ibm.p2: Now part of an AI development team, where I build evaluation tools for our in-house AI models, including RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) applications. Written in Python, they use Azure AI Foundry's built-in evaluators to score outputs on quality metrics such as groundedness and relevance.

devpro.org: DevPro · consulting for Farm Credit Canada
devpro.p1: Built and maintained web applications with Spring Boot (Java) on the server and Angular, HTML and CSS in the browser.
devpro.p2: Involved in every stage of delivery, from requirements and design to testing, release and support, working in an Agile/Scrum team with sprint planning, code reviews and retrospectives.

esl.p1: At the start of each term (August and January) I welcomed students newly joining the ESL program and helped them settle in, from practical matters like getting their student cards and transit passes to getting to know the university. For students with limited English, I also offered basic interpreting in Chinese and Japanese.
